description_en: Modifies the source and target instances of a Data Transmission Service (DTS) task
name: ModifyDBClusterMigrationEndpoint

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173433.html operation to view information about all clusters in the destination region, including the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173433.html接口查看目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The parameters for modifying the DTS task.

dtsJobId: The ID of the DTS task.

endpoint: The endpoint to switch. Set the value to src for the source endpoint or dst for the destination endpoint.

endpointInstanceId: The ID of the cloud instance
parameters.help_zh:
修改DTS任务指向的参数：

dtsJobId：dts任务id。

endpoint：切换dts源端：src 切换dts目标端：dst。

endpointInstanceId：云实例Id
parameters.name: migration_config
